title: Skull Rabbit Portal
description: A surreal painting features a large cracked circular portal with a white skull containing a detailed brain and green leaves, one red eye, set against a red and magenta dripping background. Below, a brown rabbit with a pink eye sits inside a swirling vortex of concentric circles and red poppies, while a black rabbit silhouette with three skull eyes and red drips appears on the right. A colorful staircase leads upward through green vines and more poppies.
prompt: surreal symbolic artwork showing a cracked circular portal with a white skull revealing a brain with green vines, one glowing red eye, dripping red liquid against a deep red and magenta background, below a realistic brown rabbit with pink eye sitting in a swirling brown and beige vortex filled with red poppies, black rabbit silhouette with three skull eyes on the right, colorful red orange green staircase leading through green vines and poppies, detailed symbolic painting style with dripping effects
